subject: Karnataka MLC results and the fig leaf
alt: Satish Acharya's cartoon: in an office with brown walls, a big purple-brown chair stands empty. On the wooden desk in front of it is a triangular nameplate reading 'CEC'. From behind the desk an old man with glasses and white hair peeps out, frightened; only his eyes and fingers show above the desk. From the left, a hand in a yellow sleeve holds out a dry brown leaf that looks like a fig leaf. Above the leaf, with an arrow, is written 'KARNATAKA MLC RESULTS'. A speech bubble below says: 'PLEASE WEAR THIS AND COME OUT, SIR!' The cartoonist's signature in the corner: SATISH ACHARYA.
chutki: The chair is empty and the nameplate says CEC. Its owner is hiding behind the desk, only his eyes and fingers showing. From outside, a hand holds out a dry leaf and pleads: wear this and come out, sir. The leaf is labelled: Karnataka MLC results.

Satish Acharya's jab lies in the fig leaf. In the old saying, this leaf covers shame. Here the result itself is that leaf, and the cartoon asks how much a single result can cover when the head of the Election Commission hesitates to face questions. The chair hiding behind the desk and the hand reaching in from outside together repeat the question that stands at the Commission's door these days.
